moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-typewriter, written here): Chars appear one at a time with no fade (a hard step), 80 ms per char (12 cps; demo min(1/12 s, 1.6 s/n) so long lines fit 1.6 s), first char at 0.35 s; no caret. AE: Range Selector Start 0 → 100 %, Smoothness 0 %. Erase (recipe) runs 2–3× faster (≈30–40 ms per char, last char first); the demo instead clears the line at 2.95–3.05 s. Loop 3.2 s. Params: rate: ký tự mỗi giây (12) · erase: tốc độ xoá (nhanh gấp 2–3 lần) · caret: không.
